R15_OLT_MAX_DISTANCE.description: Maximum path length from OLT to any ONT must not exceed 20 km
validation_criteria: Path length from OLT to ONT ≤ 20,000 m
All ONT paths must be complete (reach OLT)

R16_OLT_PLACEMENT_STRATEGY.description: Simplified pocket-based OLT placement: If there is a pocket of ONTs, those pockets need their own OLT. Large communities (≥2000) and medium communities (500-2000) always get OLT. Isolated small communities (>15km from others) also get OLT. User can review and optimize later.
validation_criteria: Cluster ONTs into initial pockets by proximity (2 km radius)
Iteratively merge pockets that are <15km apart
After merging, validate merged pocket diameter (must be ≤15km)
If merged pocket diameter >15km, split into smaller pockets
When adding new community, check distance to all existing pockets and merge if <15km
Re-validate all pockets after each merge operation
If pocket ≥ 2000 ONTs → always place OLT at pocket centroid
If pocket 500-2000 ONTs → always place OLT at pocket centroid (user can review/remove later)
If pocket < 500 ONTs and >15km from nearest pocket → place OLT (isolated pocket)
If pocket < 500 ONTs and ≤15km from nearest pocket → assign to nearest OLT (within 20 km)
Validate: All ONTs within 20km of assigned OLT (R15)
User review: Flag OLTs <5km apart for potential merging

recommendations.suggested_olt_count_increase: Consider additional OLTs if violation rate > 5%
recommendations.placement_priority: Pocket-based placement: Each ONT pocket gets its own OLT (500+ subscribers or isolated). User can review and optimize later.
recommendations.simplification_rationale: Simplified logic: 500-2000 always gets OLT (consistent with 2000+ rule). User can review and remove redundant OLTs during optimization phase.
